Now before you write off this review since it says I haven't played all that much of the game, I did get all the trophies for it on PS4. Hollow Knight is THE metroidvania game. it's the best one for newcomers to the genre, it's the best ones for veterans of the genre who have already played games like Symphony of The Night or Metroid as well as their many sequels. I went into the game very very unsure if I'd enjoy it and in just an hour and some change i was hooked and dedicated months to doing just about everything in the game. The combat is perfectly balanced, the movement once you have all the abilities the game makes you find is amazingly smooth, the soundtrack is way too good for a game at this scale and the story while not direct is just enough to make you curious. it's a challenging but amazing romp all the way through. So if you're even slightly considering trying it out. do it. Even if you have to use a guide. It's still worth it.
